note: Accepted high/critical advisories from `bun audit` at the time the guard was introduced. The guard (scripts/dependency-audit.ts --check) fails CI on any NEW high/critical advisory not listed here, while these known ones are tracked for resolution via the weekly dependency sweep. All current entries are transitive (build tooling, the MCP SDK's HTTP stack, websocket/undici in deps) with no direct reachable exploit path in the API's own runtime. Remove an entry once the dependency is bumped past the fix; the guard warns when a listed advisory is no longer present so the baseline can be ratcheted down.

accepted.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
accepted.reason: Every zod 4 consumer resolves to a release outside the advisory range (>=4.6.6). The remaining reported copies are zod 3.25.76, for which no patched 3.x release exists (accepted 2026-10-24): @mcp-ui/client (pinned 7.1.1, latest, declares zod ^3.23.8) is loaded only in the browser through @tanstack/ai-react's MCP app resource renderer, so validation runs on the viewer's own client and never in the API or web server; @expo/cli (declares zod ^3.25.76 through its latest release) is @stll/mobile developer tooling outside the shipped app and server images. The acceptance is temporary: it lapses on 2026-11-23 or once the advisory is no longer reported. untilPatched is not set because zod 4.6.6 already exists, which would lapse the acceptance for copies that cannot take it.
